selection_process: The selection process varies by post group as per R&P Rules
Recruitment is based on a competitive examination as per Schedule-IV (Part-G) of the R&P Rules
2015. Final Merit List shall be drawn on the basis of marks obtained in the written test.

Candidates will be shortlisted in the ratio 1:3 for Evaluation/Document Verification on the basis of marks obtained in Matriculation (calculated out of 85 marks based on percentage) and 15 marks awarded for evaluation of documents. Final merit list shall be drawn on the basis of marks obtained in educational qualification and evaluation.
how_to_apply: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://highcourt.hp.gov.in/ or https://www.hphcrecruitment.in/login.
Ensure eligibility in respect of essential qualification, category, age, and experience before applying.
Fill out the online application form with the required personal and educational details.
Upload scanned copies of required documents including photo, signature, matric certificate, ID proof, and other certificates in specified size and formats.
Pay the examination fee through online mode.
Submit the online application form on or before 27 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Take a printout or screenshot of the successfully submitted application for your record.
important_instructions: Applications are acceptable ONLY IN ONLINE MODE. Applications received through any other mode will be rejected straightway. The experience and qualification shall be reckoned as on the date of submission of online application. Candidates already in government or semi-government service must submit their online application through proper channel along with an NOC addressed to the Registrar General within 15 days from the last date. The category once claimed shall be treated final and no representation will be entertained. Expired category certificates will be considered under the UR category. Re-checking or re-evaluation of answer sheets at any stage is not allowed. Eligible candidates will be informed through SMS alerts and emails regarding test schedules; no separate call letters will be sent by post.

content_sections.heading: HP High Court Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates for appointment must be an Indian National and possess requisite education and other qualifications as prescribed under R&P Rules, 2015 as on the date of submission of online application.

rows.qualification_required: Graduation with post graduate diploma in Library Science or Bachelor or Master's degree in Library Science. Must have experience of 3 years as Library Attendant or on higher post in the related field in any reputed organization including public institution.
Must have passed Matriculation from a recognized Board.
Must have passed Matriculation from a recognized Board, along with 3 years' experience in gardening, etc.

Must have passed Matriculation from a recognized Board, along with 3 years' experience in a govt. undertaking or reputed hotel in cooking. Preference shall be given to persons acquainted with local customs and dialects where to be deployed.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the High Court of Himachal Pradesh, Shimla.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are advertised under HP High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 15 vacancies are advertised for Librarian, Peon, Mali, and Cook-cum-Attendant posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications and pay the fee is 27 October 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Peon post?
faq.answer: Candidates for the Peon post must have passed Matriculation from a recognized Board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for unreserved candidates?
faq.answer: The age limit for unreserved (UR) and EWS candidates is between 18 to 45 years, reckoned as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for reserved categories of H.P.?
faq.answer: The examination fee for reserved categories of H.P. (SC, ST, OBC, EWS) and PH categories is Rs. 300/- including GST.

faq.question: Q7. Is offline application accepted?
faq.answer: No, applications are acceptable only in online mode through the designated recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q8. How is selection done for Group-D posts like Peon and Mali?
faq.answer: Selection for Group-D posts is based on shortlisting in the ratio 1:3 based on Matriculation marks, followed by document verification and evaluation marks.
